messages:
nina-docs: Heads-up: I'm drafting a migration guide for ScalePolicy v1 -> v2 targeting Dedicated customers. Main ask: include a tiny terraform example and a table of deprecated fields + replacements. Draft PR at https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/1302.
alex-tf: Nice! Can you add a terraform snippet showing how to set isolation labels + reserved_pool_id? That's what most infra teams ask for.
jules: also please call out behavior for cooldownSeconds vs cooldown_ms (we changed units in v2) — that tripped a customer last month.
nina-docs: agreed. I'll add a clear 'units changed' note and a one-line checklist for migration testers.
amy-product: Legal asked we avoid SLA-sounding language. For the migration doc we should say "expected behavior under typical load" not "guaranteed".
eng-runtime-bot: FYI: deprecation timeline: v1 schema deprecated in two releases; v1 will be accepted during the compatibility window, but v2 should be recommended. Also note: 'burstPool' field in v1 maps to 'reservedPoolRef' in v2 and requires explicit namespace.
alex-tf: sample terraform snippet suggestion:
```hcl
resource "redwood_scale_policy" "tenant_burst" {
  name            = "tenant-burst"
  min_replicas    = 2
  max_replicas    = 8
  cooldown_ms     = 300000
  metrics {
    type   = "RequestRate"
    target = 200
  }
  labels = {
    "redwood.isolation" = "tenant-42"
  }
  reserved_pool_ref = "teams/infra/reserved-pool-east"
}
```
nina-docs: Perfect — I'll include that, and also a short YAML->HCL mapping table.
jules: please add a tiny note about runtime fallback: if reserved_pool_ref isn't found we'll route to shared pool which may preempt under load. Helps set expectations.
amy-product: Add a short blurb on how this impacts billing: "using reserved pools routes to committed capacity; costs are billed to reserved pool owner". Keep it non-normative.
devx-bot: Preview site for PR 1302 deployed: https://deploys.redwood.com/preview/1302 (expires in 7 days)
eng-runtime-bot: One extra compatibility note: metrics.type accepted aliases: RequestRate (preferred), QPS (legacy). cooldown field: v1 used seconds, v2 uses ms. We'll add an automated lint rule in the SDK to flag seconds usage.
alex-tf: Can we include a tiny test case snippet for the terraform provider docs to assert cooldown_ms present? I can open a quick follow-up.
nina-docs: Yes please. I'll leave a TODO in the doc and link to your test PR when it's ready.
jules: small nit: change the example label key from redwood.isolation to redwood.tenant.isolation to match our label convention.
nina-docs: done. Will merge once devx CI is green and product sign-off on the billing wording. Thanks for quick reviews! :raised_hands:
